title: Online Monitoring Framework for Automotive Time Series Data using JEPA Embeddings
abstract: arXiv:2602.09985v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: As autonomous vehicles are rolled out, measures must be taken to ensure their safe operation. In order to supervise a system that is already in operation, monitoring frameworks are frequently employed. These run continuously online in the background, supervising the system status and recording anomalies. This work proposes an online monitoring framework to detect anomalies in object state representations. Thereby, a key challenge is creating a framework for anomaly detection without anomaly labels, which are usually unavailable for unknown anomalies. To address this issue, this work applies a self-supervised embedding method to translate object data into a latent representation space. For this, a JEPA-based self-supervised prediction task is constructed, allowing training without anomaly labels and the creation of rich object embeddings. translated_title: 基于JEPA嵌入的汽车时间序列数据在线监测框架
translated_abstract: 随着自动驾驶车辆的推出，必须采取措施确保其安全运行。为了监督已经在运行中的系统，通常会采用监测框架。这些框架在后台持续在线运行，监控系统状态并记录异常。本工作提出了一种在线监测框架，用于检测目标状态表示中的异常。其中一个关键挑战是在没有异常标签的情况下构建异常检测框架，而对于未知异常，异常标签通常是不可获得的。为解决这一问题，本工作采用了一种自监督嵌入方法，将目标数据转换到潜在表示空间中。为此，构建了一个基于JEPA的自监督预测任务，使得无需异常标签即可进行训练，并生成丰富的目标嵌入。由此得到的具有强表达能力的JEPA嵌入可作为现有异常检测方法的输入。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于JEPA自监督嵌入的在线监测框架，无需异常标签即可检测汽车目标状态表示中的异常，为自动驾驶车辆的安全运行监控提供了新方案。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an online monitoring framework that leverages JEPA self-supervised embeddings to detect anomalies in automotive object state representations without requiring anomaly labels, enabling safe operation supervision for autonomous vehicles.
